summary: [standards] No test reaches the Postgres tier's new behaviour: PgTier::write_rows KeyConflict + one-transaction rollback across chunks, PgTier::rekey (migrate) and the journal revert are never executed, not even behind the CANON_PG_DSN live gate (pg_tier_live.rs gained no test; its only diff is one line). The ledger_naming_08 doc comment says Postgres 'is covered by its own live test' - no such test exists. The brief's F1 acceptance names Postgres explicitly and its Q2 assumption says tier key changes are confirmed 'by code and tests'. Code read: write_rows/rekey mirror the sqlite ones, but nothing proves it. Fix: add live-gated tests in pg_tier_live.rs (batch >500 rows with a conflict in chunk 2 leaves no row; rekey onto a key held by other JSON refuses and keeps nothing; migrate --commit then --revert restores the rows), and correct the comment. Blast radius: canon's own canon.yaml routes task/session/run/event/handoff/trajectory to Postgres, so F4's query comparison could not cover those kinds either (both binaries: QUERY_FAILED, no DSN).
